wary.speaker: Pell Harrow
wary.text: You are the one who walked out of the wreck. Funny. Wrecks round here give back bodies, not people.

choices.text: I have nothing to say to you.

wary2.speaker: Pell Harrow
wary2.text: No. Nobody does. Keep your hands off what is not yours on that beach, that is all. Salvage rights belong to the village.

bones.speaker: Pell Harrow
bones.text: I walked that shore at dawn, as I have since I was a boy. The old bones, the big ones, the ones every child here has climbed on: gone. No drag marks I could follow, only scorching. Do not look at me like that. I am not drunk.
